hoyo-de-monterrey-hn--hoyo-de-monterrey-.description: The classic Hoyo de Monterrey is handmade in Cofradía, Honduras, from aged Honduran and Dominican long filler and a Connecticut binder, under either an Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper or a dark Connecticut Broadleaf maduro. It is a layered, traditional Honduran smoke with an easy draw and a rich finish.

sources.title: JR Cigar – Hoyo de Monterrey lines
Cigar Place – Hoyo de Monterrey lines

hoyo-de-monterrey-hn--hoyo-de-tradicion.description: Created to honour the brand's long history, Hoyo de Tradición is a box-pressed Honduran cigar with an oily Viso Rosado wrapper from the Jamastran Valley, a Connecticut-grown Habano binder and aged filler from San Agustín, the Dominican Republic and Ometepe. Aromatic and hearty, it carries nutty undertones and a natural sweetness.

sources.title: JR Cigar – Hoyo de Tradición
JR Cigar – Hoyo de Monterrey lines

hoyo-de-monterrey-hn--hoyo-la-amistad-go.description: Part of Hoyo's La Amistad series, the Gold is made at Tabacalera Fernández in Nicaragua, with filler drawn from four of the country's main growing regions. Bold and full-bodied, it balances a natural sweetness against spice in a modern reading of the Hoyo style.

sources.title: Cigar Place – Hoyo de Monterrey lines
JR Cigar – Hoyo de Monterrey lines

hoyo-de-monterrey-hn--hoyo-la-amistad-si.description: Released in 2017 and made at Tabacalera AJ Fernández, La Amistad Silver wraps Nicaraguan tobacco from Fernández's own farms in Estelí and Condega, with a Nicaraguan Habano binder, in an Ecuadorian Habano leaf. Medium-full in body, it moves from pepper and dark coffee through wood and espresso to dark chocolate.

thirds.notes: Gentler than expected, with restrained pepper, dark coffee and aged-tobacco sweetness; one taster found earth and raisin.
Wood, pepper and espresso form the core with some nuttiness, turning brighter and citrusy past the midpoint.
The citrus fades into darker coffee and dark chocolate as strength edges toward full.

sources.title: Blind Man's Puff – Hoyo La Amistad Silver Robusto
JR Cigar – Hoyo de Monterrey lines

hoyo-de-monterrey-hn--hoyo-la-amistad-bl.description: La Amistad Black, part of Hoyo's La Amistad series, wraps Nicaraguan Habano filler and a Mexican San Andrés binder in a dark Ecuadorian Sumatra oscuro leaf. It is a powerful, spicy smoke, with cinnamon, leather and a hot-sauce heat, best suited to experienced smokers.

sources.title: Cigar Place – Hoyo de Monterrey lines
JR Cigar – Hoyo de Monterrey lines

hoyo-de-monterrey-hn--hoyo-la-amistad-da.description: La Amistad Dark Sumatra, released in 2019, is AJ Fernández's version of the Hoyo Dark Sumatra, made with General Cigar: an Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper over a Connecticut Broadleaf binder and aged Nicaraguan, Dominican and Honduran filler. Medium to full in body, it brings earth, wood, pepper and espresso with cocoa and leather.

thirds.notes: Earthy, with a balanced sweet pepper, cedar and strong black coffee; cocoa and leather follow.
The sweetness recedes as the profile turns woody and nutty, with damp cedar, walnut and traces of chocolate and cinnamon.
Leather, wood and nuts dominate, black pepper grows and a touch of anise returns at the finish.

hoyo-de-monterrey-hn--hoyo-de-monterrey-.description: Introduced in 2024 and made at the HATSA factory in Danlí, Honduras, Hoyo de Monterrey Oscuro wraps Dominican, Honduran and Nicaraguan filler and an Ecuadorian Sumatra binder in dark Brazilian Mata Fina. Medium to full, it mixes molasses and cola-like sweetness with cayenne and white pepper and a rye-bread note.

hoyo-de-monterrey-hn--hoyo-de-monterrey-.description: Launched in 2024 with the Oscuro and made in Danlí, Honduras, Hoyo de Monterrey Rojo uses a Honduran Jamastran wrapper and Nicaraguan binder around Honduran, Nicaraguan and Dominican filler. A comfortable medium, it shows cinnamon and earthy sweetness, toasted bread and a toasted-marshmallow, molasses richness in the middle.

thirds.notes: Earthy sweetness with cinnamon, a hint of toasted bread and a mild spice.
Toasty and rich, with toasted marshmallow and molasses; the spice fades and touches of citrus appear.
Citrus lingers and the strength rises slightly toward the end.
